verdict.rationale: Discord's webhooks docs say apps can 'receive event notifications from Discord delivered to your app over HTTP' (discord-docs-56), which is a first-party outbound HTTP event delivery capability. Most of the other webhook evidence describes incoming webhooks for posting messages into channels (discord-docs-5, discord-docs-43), which do not count. The Gateway is WebSocket-based and is an adjacent feature, not webhooks. missing for 10: documented list of subscribable event types, endpoint registration/configuration details, payload signing or verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
